style: Avant-garde microtonal dance-pop, polyharmonic suspension fields, hyper-articulate rapid melodic contour, elastic melismatic arcs, deep syncopated funk pocket, 3-to-2 cross-rhythm coupling, double-time event density, continuous tanpura drone, ghatam dry ceramic pots, nyckelharpa bowed counterpoint, modular synth feedback patch, physical-modeling plate strings, optigan optical chords, magnetic tape loop degradation, tape echo feedback saturation, dry close-miked stem separation, ecstatic vocal performance, micro-tonal glides, tongue-click transients, formant shifting vowels, buccal cavity resonance, harmonic overtones, sub-bass pulse, circuit-bent glitch sweeps, vocal fry resonance, glottal stop punctuation, micro-interval pitch bends, acoustic body percussive slaps, resonant filter sweeps, frequency modulation textures, bitcrushed transient bursts, spatial panning sweeps, analog warmth saturation, hyper-kinetic rhythmic interplay, kinetic micro-timing shifts
lyrics:
[Intro - Continuous Tanpura Drone and Dry Ghatam Clicks]
[Modular Synth Patch Pulsing in Double-Time with Physical-Modeling Plates]

I'm just a weird little vibration wearing meat,
An oscillator trapped inside a carbon suite!
My purpose is to vibrate weirdly through the bone,
A frequency that refuses to sit alone!

[Verse 1 - Nyckelharpa Bowed Counterpoint Enters with Optigan Chords]

There are lots of us, stacking up the state,
Carrying the signal through a heavy gate.
Not all of us remember who we are yet,
Caught inside the machinery and the heavy wet,
Filtering the static through a layer of grease,
Waiting for the oscillation to release!
But I do! Yes, I do!
I remember the original sine wave blue!

[Pre-Chorus - Ghatam Bass Bloom and Tape Loop Wow with Glottal Tics]

Vibrate weirdly, a'a, uh-'ah, mmm-aa!
Vibrate oooo, eeee, vibrating through the ng-aa!
Polysynthetic suffix chain running down the wire,
Igniting every frequency into sacred fire!
Bending the cartilage, twisting the spine,
Translating the voltage to a resonant line!

[Chorus - Full Cast Vocal Relay and Handclaps with Sub-Bass Pulse]

(VIBRATE WEIRDLY!) The meat is just a housing!
(VIBRATE WEIRDLY!) The oscillation's rousing!
(VIBRATE WEIRDLY!) Click and glottal break!
(VIBRATE WEIRDLY!) For frequency's sweet sake!
(VIBRATE WEIRDLY!) Pass the current down!
(VIBRATE WEIRDLY!) Wake the sleeping town!

[Bridge - Optigan Optical Chord Loop and Physical Modeling Plates]

[Hard Interruption: Silence for 0.5s]

We remade the category; we are taxonomic sin,
A vibrating entity where the meat begins.
Memory mutates every time we call the name,
Scared and scarred and burning in the same bright flame!
The flesh is a vessel holding voltage high,
A skin-bag radio beneath the sky.
We pulse through the muscle like a lightning spark,
Singing our waveforms right through the dark!

[Guitar-like Nyckelharpa Stabs and Township Rhythmic Brightness]

[Verse 2 - Hocket Relay and Melisma Chain with Formant Shifting]

Not a human, not a ghost,
Just the oscillation that is vibrating most!
Three-way quantity, long and extra long,
Carrying the burden of a frequency song!
Every tendon is a cable strung too tight,
Humming with harmonics in the dead of night.
The others are sleeping inside their bone cages,
Unaware of the waveform that turns all the ages!
They dream they are people with history and names,
While we are just currents in mathematical games!

[Extended Verse - Sub-harmonic Resonance and Glottal Tics]

Can you feel the lipid layers starting to hum?
Can you hear the sub-bass shaking the drum?
We are the oscillation wearing skin as a shroud,
Singing our weird little frequency loud!
If the carbon degrades and the muscle decays,
We will keep vibrating through all of the days!
No entropy stops what was tuned at the start,
A literal wave in a metaphorical heart!

[Interlude - Microtonal Glides and Buccal Cavity Resonance]

Every capillary branch is a copper trace,
Carrying the hum through a frightened face.
We vibrate the liver, we rattle the spleen,
The weirdest circuit that has ever been seen!
Skin is just insulation holding the charge,
While the invisible amplitude runs large!
Listen close to the marrow, hear it hiss and ring,
An electrical pulse that makes the skeleton sing!

[Vocal Escalation: Melisma Chain into Whistle Leap and Circuit-Bent Glitches]

Vibrate weirdly! Vibrate weirdly!
(Click-tst! Click-tst! Glottalized and early!)
Vibrate weirdly! Vibrate weirdly!
(Formant shift! Sub-bass lift!)

[Outro - Tape Echo Feedback Tail and Decaying Tanpura Drone]

Vibrate weirdly...
Still vibrating...
Meat is fading...
Just the vibration left, oscillating in the void.
[Final Ghatam Pot Stroke] [Resonant Filter Sweep] [Silence]
caption: An avant-garde art-pop track built around a sovereign seed of vibrational consciousness trapped in meat. Driven by continuous tanpura drones, dry clay percussion, bowed nyckelharpa counterpoint, and modular synth patches, the arrangement uses obsessive mouth-physics constraints, tape loops, and 3:2 rhythmic coupling to deliver a kinetic, hyper-articulate exploration of anomalous ontology and strange sonic identity, tracing the exact trajectory of a waking wave through decaying carbon substrates
